name: rigid_tank_two_compartments_water
title: Entropy change of water in a two-compartment rigid tank (exercise)
summary: A rigid tank is split into two equal compartments. One holds 2.5 kg of compressed liquid water at 400 kPa and 60 °C; the other is under vacuum. After they are connected the pressure is 40 kPa, and the model computes the entropy change of the water. Exercise 7 of repetition R4, ULiège MECA0002, 2022-2023.
